arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Edwin Kneedler argued the government side. He stated annual appropriations acts prohibit the agency from acting on relief applications. He compared the relief power to the pardon power.

Mr. Goldstein argued the opposing side side. He stated section 925(c) grants individuals the right to apply for relief. He argued the statute secures judicial review if the Secretary denies the application.
Chief Justice Rehnquist closed the argument. He stated the case is submitted.

paragraphs: This dispute defines the boundary between legislative funding controls and statutory rights. It determines whether agencies can ignore statutory duties due to budget limits. It affects access to courts for individuals seeking disability relief.
